desc: Implement the \(O(NM)\) functional-graph decomposition and tree DP.
Correctly enforce equal values on every directed cycle and combine independent components.
Verify the implementation on all samples and edge cases including self-loops, pure cycles, chains, \(M=1\), and \(N=1\).
Derive the rooted-tree transition using prefix sums for weak inequalities.
Establish the overall \(O(NM)\) target complexity and modular arithmetic requirements.
Reject unnecessary generic SCC, transfer-matrix, and linear-extension approaches.
